mentions.name: Kavla
mentions.description: Open source SQL canvas that adds interactivity to queries: typing {var} in a SQL statement pops out a knob control that infers the column's type and values, e.g. a slider for a score threshold. Includes a browser-based demo running entirely in WASM with no login.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on Kavla, my open source SQL canvas https://github.com/aleda145/kavla

I'm very excited by adding interactivity. I have a new "knob" feature that pops out when you type {var}. It infers the column's type and values.
mentions.author: aleda145
